unavoidableDifferences.TRAINING_OBJECTIVE: D is the frozen SK1 kernel: a risk head ranked by risk tier and then a separate regret head. M0 is the additive control ranked by the H-DISC ranking contract. The ranking contract therefore changes together with the data.

unavoidableDifferences.MODEL_CAPACITY: (c) the pair model reads 2d+k inputs against d+k with the same tree budget, and (d) antisymmetrisation uses every tree twice with opposite sign, which removes its symmetric part: equal tree budgets are not equal function classes
unavoidableDifferences.OPTIMISATION_BUDGET: (b) the pair model is fitted on pairs, the control on actions. The matched unit is fixed instead: same classes, same actions, every unordered pair of selectable actions once, class weights normalised so each class carries the same total weight in both arms, equal leaf-update budget
unavoidableDifferences.INFERENCE_BUDGET: (a) the pair model evaluates n(n-1) ordered pairs per menu against n actions. The ceiling is shared; consumption cannot be equal. Median and maximum milliseconds per decision and scorer evaluations per menu are both reported

mechanismQualification.label: H_DISC_MECHANISM_QUALIFICATION
mechanismQualification.statement: This analysis asks WHY a difference arises. It never changes the policy classification, and the policy classification never depends on it.
mechanismQualification.test: the primary paired test and interval, applied to the lower arm against the upper arm of each ladder contrast
mechanismQualification.precondition: the contrast verdict from assertMatchedContrast is FULLY_MATCHED or PARTIALLY_MATCHED and the trained pair arm passes the structural check

licensedClaims.SUPPORTED: On fresh classes, with the same label, the same per-action information, the same tree budget and the same tuning effort, replacing the pointwise objective by the antisymmetrised pairwise objective lowered the top-choice unsafe rate. If the contrast is PARTIALLY_MATCHED the claim must list the unavoidable differences beside it.
licensedClaims.NOT_SUPPORTED: The pairwise objective, with the same information, did not lower the top-choice unsafe rate, and a contribution as large as half of the total F-against-D effect is excluded. Any F-against-D gain is then attributed to the other rungs or left unattributed.
licensedClaims.UNRESOLVED: The contrast cannot tell no contribution from a contribution of half the total effect. This is not a negative finding and not a positive one.
licensedClaims.NOT_TESTABLE: No statement about the pairwise objective may be made: the arms were not matched, could not be built, or the trained pair model has no path that splits on both actions and is therefore an additive ranker in pair form.
licensedClaims.NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_TOTAL_EFFECT: F did not improve on D, so there is no effect to attribute.

mechanismQualification.neverLicensed: An improvement of F over D, however large, never licenses the statement that pairwise learning caused it. F differs from D in data, label, information, objective and pair-specific inputs at once. Only the matched M2-against-M3a contrast speaks to the pairwise objective, and only at the strength its verdict allows.

mechanismQualification.expectedPower: adjacent contrasts are powered only for large effects at 900 classes; UNRESOLVED is the likely outcome for a modest contribution and is not a negative finding

sharedConfigurationRule.rule: Every ladder arm is fitted at every grid configuration, out of fold over five origin-family folds. ONE configuration is selected for all arms: the one minimising the sum over the five ladder arms of out-of-fold top-choice unsafe classes. Ties: smaller treesPerBag x maxDepth, then smaller learningRate.
sharedConfigurationRule.consequence: equal tree budget and equal tuning effort for every arm by construction; no arm is tuned on its own
sharedConfigurationRule.noteOnDvsM0: the D-to-M0 step is capacity-matched only if the selected configuration equals the SK1 risk-head budget; otherwise that step is NOT_TESTABLE and is reported so

negativeResultRules.wellPoweredNull: If the confirmatory test does not reject and the power re-estimated on exploration for a halving is at least 0.8, the result is recorded as evidence for a public-information limit at that effect size in these menus.
negativeResultRules.underPoweredNull: If re-estimated power is below 0.8 the non-rejection is recorded as inconclusive, not as evidence for a limit.
negativeResultRules.noAutomaticFollowUp: No result, positive or negative, authorizes another campaign, a larger sample, a changed target or a changed model.
negativeResultRules.noSoftening: The decision class is assigned by the rule fixed here. Post hoc subgroups, alternative endpoints and alternative thresholds are labelled exploratory and change nothing.

pairedEffectSizeInterval.note: expected half-width of the two-sided 95% interval for the paired difference in top-choice unsafe rate (F minus D), normal approximation on effective classes, for a true halving; the reported interval is the origin-family cluster bootstrap

absoluteQualificationIsNotMadeLikely.statement: Nine hundred classes improve the power to detect a relative effect. They do not make absolute qualification likely: Contract A requires zero introductions, and more classes make zero harder to observe, not easier.

sharpenings.label: SHARPENED_NOT_CHANGED
sharpenings.topic: rejection rule of the primary test
sharpenings.hdisc0: test: one-sided exact sign (McNemar) test on discordant classes, alpha = 0.05; reported interval: origin-family cluster bootstrap of the paired difference
sharpenings.here: H0 is rejected only if the exact sign test gives p <= 0.05 AND the one-sided 95% origin-family cluster-bootstrap upper bound of the paired difference is below 0
sharpenings.why: the H-DISC-0 power model already divides classes by a design effect, which presumes a decision that respects clustering; the added condition can only make rejection harder

sharpenings.label: SHARPENED_NOT_CHANGED
sharpenings.topic: what "matched" means for M2 against M3a
sharpenings.hdisc0: same label, same information, same learner family, same capacity budget, same compute budget; only the objective differs
sharpenings.here: equal tree budget and a shared compute ceiling; the objective differs by design; three differences cannot be removed (input width and antisymmetrisation; pairs as the training unit; quadratic pair evaluations) and are declared, so the best reachable verdict is PARTIALLY_MATCHED
sharpenings.why: H-DISC-0 itself says a contrast whose capacity or compute cannot be equalised is PARTIALLY_MATCHED

sharpenings.label: SHARPENED_NOT_CHANGED
sharpenings.hdisc0: M0 isolates new data only (against D)
sharpenings.here: under the fixed model-family interface M0 is ranked by the H-DISC ranking contract while D ranks by risk tier and a separate regret head, so the ranking contract changes together with the data; the step is PARTIALLY_MATCHED at best
sharpenings.why: the definition of M0 is unchanged; the attribution strength is stated honestly

sharpenings.label: SHARPENED_NOT_CHANGED
sharpenings.hdisc0: if out-of-fold evidence on exploration does not show F's top-choice unsafe rate below D's on the same classes, the campaign stops before validation
sharpenings.here: F's out-of-fold top-choice unsafe COUNT must be strictly below frozen D's count on the same exploration classes; no significance requirement; D is applied frozen

sharpenings.label: SHARPENED_NOT_CHANGED
sharpenings.hdisc0: SUPPORTED, NOT_SUPPORTED, or UNRESOLVED when the interval includes both zero and half the total effect
sharpenings.here: SUPPORTED: the test rejects and the clustered interval lies below zero. UNRESOLVED: the interval includes zero and half the total effect. NOT_SUPPORTED: it includes zero and excludes half the total effect. Two labels added for cases H-DISC-0 named in prose: NOT_TESTABLE and NOT_APPLICABLE_NO_TOTAL_EFFECT

sharpenings.label: SHARPENED_NOT_CHANGED
sharpenings.topic: equal capacity and equal tuning effort
sharpenings.hdisc0: an equal capacity budget; equal tuning effort: the same number of configurations tried by the same pre-registered rule
sharpenings.here: one configuration shared by all ladder arms, selected by a rule that sums out-of-fold failures over the arms
sharpenings.why: separate tuning per arm would let capacities differ and would break the matching

sharpenings.label: RESOLVED_BY_OWNER_MANDATE
sharpenings.hdisc0: 900 recommended; 600 only with a pre-registered 60% effect
sharpenings.why: fixed in the H-DISC-1 owner mandate; the 600-class alternative is dropped
